newsitem.title: USA: Apple Computer stake held by Saudi prince.
newsitem.headline: Apple Computer stake held by Saudi prince.

text.p: Saudi billionaire Prince Alwaleed Bin Talal said Wednesday in a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission that he holds just over five percent of Apple Computer Inc, or 6,233,550 shares.

He has been following the technology industry, Apple Computer in particular, for a number of months and believes there is "serious potential for the issuer to provide large returns to its stockholders as it did in the past."

He plans to review Apple's business and prospects before determining any future course, or alternatives. However, depending on market conditions, he may acquire additional shares, or dispose of all or a portion of his stake.
Although he has no plans to seek control of the company's board or any other material changes, he "reserves the right to and may in the future" change his intentions.
He most recently bought shares between March 17 and April 1 at prices ranging from $16.05 to $19.425 each.
